usedFor: Woodpecker runs email outreach, and “Prospect Interested” there can share a Google Drive file through “Share File With Anyone”.

bestTemplate.name: “Prospect Interested” in Woodpecker, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A prospect marked INTERESTED can trigger a shareable link at the access level you set.

watchOut: “Prospect Saved” fires when a prospect is created or updated, so the same prospect can share the file twice.
